hints.title: Prefix XOR Relation
hints.text: By definition, pref[i] = pref[i - 1] xor arr[i] for all i >= 1.

hints.title: Inverting XOR Operations
hints.text: Xor-ing both sides with pref[i - 1] isolates arr[i] = pref[i - 1] xor pref[i].

hints.title: Base Element
hints.text: The first element arr[0] is simply pref[0].

hints.title: Adjacent Prefix XOR Extraction Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass extracting adjacent XOR differences.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing prefixes iteratively takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for the resulting array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies XOR self-inverse property to recover original values in a single pass.
